senses.gloss: m. (פָּלַל) pleading, pillul, one of the terms for prayer.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 26:7">Sifré Deut. 26</cite>; <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 811:1">Yalk. ib. 811</cite>.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 260:4">Yalk. Ex. 260</cite> <he>עלה פ׳ תפלתן וכ׳</he> (not <he>תכלתן</he>) the pleading of the prayer of the patriarchs arose &c.; (Mekh. B’shall., Vayassʿa, s. 3 <he>עלתה תפלתן</he>).
